text:
olivia: Quick recap from the call with ChainWorks (LangChain distro) + IndexMate (LlamaIndex fork). They want a certified connector that plugs into our gateway and shows up in their marketplace. Capturing next steps here.
jun: TL;DR: we build an adapter that implements our route API + a small sample repo showing LangChain/IndexMate chaining with our streaming and tool-calls.
raj: technical constraints: support streaming, tool-calling, and embeddings. Also need a self-hosted test harness for partners to validate.
olivia: partner ask: marketplace listing + joint docs + co-branded quickstart. timeline they'd prefer: 6 weeks.
partners-bot: Intake submitted: https://partners.example.com/flows/CW-501 1 contact: hello@chainworks.ai 1 status: partner-intake-acknowledged.
jun: auth plan: OAuth2 client_credentials for adapter-to-partner control plane, short-lived signing key for route calls. sample config idea: 
```
connector:
  name: redwood-llm-orch-connector
  upstream_route: https://api.redwood.example/v1/gateway
  auth: oauth2
  features: [streaming, tool_calls, embeddings]
```
raj: tests: 1) chain orchestration example (LLM -> retriever -> reranker), 2) streaming SSE test, 3) embedding consistency with RFC spec. I'll own test harness.
lisa: GTM note: marketing needs 1-pager, 3 screenshots, and a demo script. Also need a co-announcement checklist (logo approvals, embargo time, quote).
jun: observability: add per-connector latency panels, prefix-cache hit-rate, and a request lineage trace to map calls through LangChain flows.
olivia: product ask: add a feature flag `llm_orch_partner_cw` to gate docs until NDA is cleared.
partners-bot: NDA status: pending signature from ChainWorks legal. Reminder: no public assets until NDA done.
raj: compatibility risk: IndexMate uses a custom document store protocol; we'll map it to our embeddings surface but may need a shim for chunking. plan: adapter will implement chunking hooks.
lisa: webinar vs blog? partner prefers a developer workshop + repo walkthrough. Suggest schedule dev workshop in week 7, blog after.
jun: rollout plan: internal preview -> partner sandbox -> public marketplace. Feature flag rollout and canary on 10% of traffic for 48h.
olivia: owners: jun -> connector spec + auth flow, raj -> test harness + chunking shim, lisa -> GTM assets & co-announce checklist, olivia -> partner comms + NDA follow-up.
partners-bot: ChainWorks assigned to olivia. PR template recommended: partners/chainworks-connector.
jun: will open initial draft PR tomorrow with basic adapter and a sample LangChain pipeline in examples/.
raj: will add automated smoke test that runs the chain and validates tokens and embedding vectors.
lisa: i'll start the 1-pager and drop screenshots requests into the partner workspace.
olivia: OK, please update this thread with PR link and NDA status. Meet again Tuesday 9am PT for sync. :rocket:
